sections.title: 2. Description of the App
paragraphs: Loquor AAC is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) application designed to help individuals with speech difficulties communicate through symbols, text, and optional AI-powered voice synthesis. Features include:
items: Optional third-party voice synthesis via user-supplied API keys

The App may be used by children under the supervision of a parent, guardian, or caregiver. The adult responsible for the user's device accepts these Terms on their behalf.
